summary: The administrator courses card header and its 'Add course' button unexpectedly changed color schemes instead of only updating text, which introduces unintended visual regressions.

regressions.explanation: The 'Courses' card header background changed from primary blue (rgb(13, 110, 253)) to secondary gray (rgb(108, 117, 125)), which is an unintended color change unrelated to updating the card text.
regressions.violated_rule: Design intent: Updated the text for administrator courses card

regressions.explanation: The 'Add course' button changed from a light style with black text (rgb(248, 249, 250) background, rgb(0, 0, 0) text) to a dark style with white text (rgb(33, 37, 41) background, rgb(255, 255, 255) text), which is an unintended styling change outside the design intent.
regressions.violated_rule: Design intent: Updated the text for administrator courses card
